database.instructions: This is a collaborative writing system where users comment with tips to set the price for the next 10 words. Words are colored based on their cost: free words are green, bronze (1-49 credits) are orange, silver (50-99 credits) are gray, and golden (100+ credits) are yellow with shimmer animation. The writing_state collection tracks the current pricing and remaining words.
